visual_review: Side-view lower leg: straight shin and calf, curved ankle into a sloping instep, rounded toe, flat sole and protruding round heel, resting above an L tray (floor + back wall); reads as a leg and foot in a support.
omissions: The strap entering from the left: at 8 clearance it could only cross the shin as a bar and made the drawing read as the letter t, so it was dropped.
